description: This file defines a data access object (DAO) interface for managing ConnectionEntity objects in a local database, using Room persistence library annotations to specify database queries and operations.

classes.name: ConnectionDao
classes.description: Data access object interface providing methods to perform CRUD operations on ConnectionEntity objects stored in the local database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting all ConnectionEntity objects ordered by id descending.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Suspending function to fetch a ConnectionEntity by its primary key id.

methods.name: findByAlias
methods.description: Suspending function to find a ConnectionEntity by its alias, returning the first match.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Suspending function to insert a new ConnectionEntity or replace an existing one, returning its row id.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Suspending function to update an existing ConnectionEntity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Suspending function to delete a given ConnectionEntity.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Suspending function to delete a ConnectionEntity by its id.
